title: Supported Living Payment: eligibility (Social Security Act 2018 ss 34-40), OpenFisca Aotearoa encoding, week 2019-W01

attributes.name: supported_living_payment__restricted_work_capacity
attributes.source: SSA 2018 s 34(a), s 35; supported_living_payment.py:50 (read), :109 (input variable, default False)

attributes.name: totally_blind
attributes.source: SSA 2018 s 34(a); supported_living_payment.py:50 (read at period.start); demographics/health.py:26 (input variable, ETERNITY, default False)

attributes.name: social_security__residential_requirement
attributes.source: SSA 2018 s 16 via s 34(b) and s 40(1)(b); supported_living_payment.py:53 and :84 (read); resident.py:21 (defined term with its own formula, set directly as input, see CONVERSION.md 2)

attributes.name: age
attributes.source: SSA 2018 s 34(c) (16 or older), s 40(1)(c)(i) (18 or older without dependent children), s 40(1)(c)(ii) (20 or older); supported_living_payment.py:56, :87, :90 (age at period.start compared with literals 16, 18, 20; no parameter file); demographics/ages.py:35

attributes.name: supported_living_payment__disability_self_inflicted
attributes.source: SSA 2018 s 36; supported_living_payment.py:61 (read), :147 (input variable, ETERNITY, default False)

attributes.name: supported_living_payment__caring_for_another_person
attributes.source: SSA 2018 s 40(1)(a); supported_living_payment.py:81 (read at period.first_week), :137 (input variable, default False)

attributes.name: social_security__dependent_children
attributes.source: SSA 2018 s 40(1)(c)(i)-(ii); supported_living_payment.py:87 (== 0); interpretation/child.py:43 (int, count of dependent children, set directly as input, see CONVERSION.md 2)

output.name: supported_living_payment__entitled
output.source: supported_living_payment.py:9-38, value at week 2019-W01 of the applicant

exclusions.description: The self-inflicted flag is set although the person has neither restricted work capacity nor total blindness. The variable is defined as 'The person's restricted capacity for work, or total blindness, was self-inflicted ...', which presupposes one of the two.

period.why: The period of all 7 official entitlement cases (entitled.yaml). formula_2018_11_26 applies from 2018-11-26; it reads no parameter, so every week since then gives the same table.

household.value: the applicant alone, principal of a one-person family
household.why: The eligibility formula reads only person-level variables; dependent children enter as the count social_security__dependent_children, which the official tests also set directly.

date_of_birth.value: not set; age is set directly for every day of the week
date_of_birth.why: The official tests set age directly; the formula reads age at period.start.

notes: Applicant-level eligibility for Supported Living Payment on either ground (s 34 restricted work capacity or total blindness; s 40 carer). The two defined terms social_security__residential_requirement and social_security__dependent_children are attributes in their own right (CONVERSION.md 2). Interpretive choices and the mapping of the official cases: CONVERSION.md.
